history.content: hey there. how are you today?
Hey there — I'm here and glad you stopped by. How’s your day been so far?
ok i guess. quiet. its been a weird week tbh
Quiet, and a little weird — that gives it a particular kind of feel. What’s making the week feel weird?
my dad. it was my graduation last weekend and he just didnt show. said he would and then nothing. not even a text
That sounds really hurtful — you were there for a graduation moment, and he didn’t show or even text. Does it feel more hurt, anger, or disappointment?
hurt mostly. i shouldnt even be surprised anymore but i still kept looking at the door. dumb
Hurt, and still looking at the door — that doesn’t sound dumb at all. Did it feel more like waiting, or like a little hope that kept tugging you back?
hope i guess. always hope with him. anyway. thanks for listening. gonna go lie down for a bit
That makes sense — hope can keep showing up even when it’s been let down before. I can leave it here for now, or if you want, we can stay with what that hope has been asking for.
leave it here for now. thanks. night
Of course — goodnight, and we can leave it here.
